T: One last ride. One last feast.
D: The Guardians race to save Rocket's life and face the scientist who made him.
P: Serve the mains when the Guardians land on Counter-Earth.
S: Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, chilli oil to dip.
Cheddar cracker dough cut into bone shapes, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until crisp.
Rocket and his friends Lylla, Teefs and Floor
Roasted chickpeas and peanuts tossed with smoked paprika and garlic, baked at 200C until crunchy.
M: the copy of Earth the High Evolutionary built
Beef burgers with cheddar, lettuce and tomato on toasted buns, with fries and a pickle, an Earth diner meal done right.
Pork belly slow roasted at 160C for 3 hours, crackling blasted crisp, sliced over mash with apple sauce.
W: Rocket taking over as captain of the Guardians
Chocolate cake baked at 175C for 35 minutes, covered in fudge icing and sprinkles, a little candle on top.
K: Kraglin learning to use Yondu's arrow
Ginger beer with lime and a splash of dark rum over ice.

s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with shredded wombok, grated ginger and salt. Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat. Fry in oil until crisp underneath, add a splash of water, cover and steam 5 minutes. Serve with chilli oil and soy sauce.

s.note: Rocket and his friends Lylla, Teefs and Floor
s.how: Drain and dry 2 cans of chickpeas. Toss with 150g peanuts, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt. Roast at 200C for 30 minutes, shaking the tray, until crunchy. Cool and pile into a bowl. Do not call them trash snacks.

m.how: Score a 1.5kg pork belly, rub with salt and dry overnight. Roast at 160C for 3 hours, then blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles. Simmer chopped apples with a little water into sauce. Slice the pork over buttery mash from 1kg potatoes.

w.note: Rocket taking over as captain of the Guardians
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, then 3 eggs. Fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 250ml milk. Bake at 175C for 35 minutes. Cover with fudge icing of butter, icing sugar and cocoa, then sprinkles and one little candle on top.

d.note: Kraglin learning to use Yondu's arrow
d.how: Fill glasses with ice. Pour 30ml dark rum into each for those drinking, squeeze in half a lime and top with cold ginger beer. Leave out the rum for everyone else. Drink it on a ship with a lot of dents.
